Wrapper function to generate PHATE parameters (GPU version)

params_phate_gpu.Rd

Wrapper function to generate PHATE parameters (GPU version)

Usage

params_phate_gpu(
  decay = 40,
  bandwidth_scale = 1,
  thresh = 1e-04,
  graph_symmetry = c("additive", "multiplicative", "mnn", "none"),
  n_landmarks = 2048L,
  landmark_method = c("spectral", "random", "density"),
  n_svd = NULL,
  t_max = 100L,
  t_custom = NULL,
  gamma = 1,
  mds_method = c("sgd_dense", "classic"),
  mds_iter = NULL,
  randomised = TRUE
)

Arguments

decay

Numeric or NULL. Alpha decay exponent of the kernel. Higher values give sharper transitions. NULL gives a binary connectivity kernel. Defaults to 40.0.

bandwidth_scale

Numeric. Multiplicative factor on the kernel bandwidth. Defaults to 1.0.

thresh

Numeric. Affinities below this are set to zero. Neighbours past k join the kernel while their affinity clears it. Defaults to 1e-04.

graph_symmetry

String. How to symmetrise the affinity graph. One of c("additive", "multiplicative", "mnn", "none"). Defaults to "additive".

n_landmarks

Integer or NULL. Number of landmarks for the compressed diffusion operator. NULL, or a value of at least the number of samples, runs the full N x N operator, which gets painful fast. Defaults to 2048L.

landmark_method

String. How to select the landmarks. "spectral" runs its randomised SVD and k-means on the GPU (or on MLX with backend = "mlx"). One of c("spectral", "random", "density"). Defaults to "spectral".

n_svd

Integer or NULL. Singular vectors for spectral landmark selection. If NULL, defaults to 100 on the Rust side. Defaults to NULL.

t_max

Integer. Largest diffusion time the Von Neumann entropy knee search considers. Defaults to 100L.

t_custom

Integer or NULL. Fixed diffusion time. If NULL, picks the knee automatically. Defaults to NULL.

gamma

Numeric. Informational distance constant. 1 is the log potential. Defaults to 1.0.

mds_method

String. MDS algorithm for the final embedding. One of c("sgd_dense", "classic"). Defaults to "sgd_dense".

mds_iter

Integer or NULL. Number of SGD-MDS iterations. If NULL, the Rust side runs 300 below 1000 points, 500 below 5000 and 800 otherwise (points being the landmarks when landmarks are used). Defaults to NULL.

randomised

Boolean. Use randomised SVD for classic MDS (mds_method = "classic"). SGD-MDS initialises from a randomised classic MDS either way. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

A named list with the following elements:

  • decay - Numeric or NULL. Alpha decay exponent of the kernel. Higher values give sharper transitions. NULL gives a binary connectivity kernel. Defaults to 40.0.

  • bandwidth_scale - Numeric. Multiplicative factor on the kernel bandwidth. Defaults to 1.0.

  • thresh - Numeric. Affinities below this are set to zero. Neighbours past k join the kernel while their affinity clears it. Defaults to 1e-04.

  • graph_symmetry - String. How to symmetrise the affinity graph. One of c("additive", "multiplicative", "mnn", "none"). Defaults to "additive".

  • n_landmarks - Integer or NULL. Number of landmarks for the compressed diffusion operator. NULL, or a value of at least the number of samples, runs the full N x N operator, which gets painful fast. Defaults to 2048L.

  • landmark_method - String. How to select the landmarks. "spectral" runs its randomised SVD and k-means on the GPU (or on MLX with backend = "mlx"). One of c("spectral", "random", "density"). Defaults to "spectral".

  • n_svd - Integer or NULL. Singular vectors for spectral landmark selection. If NULL, defaults to 100 on the Rust side. Defaults to NULL.

  • t_max - Integer. Largest diffusion time the Von Neumann entropy knee search considers. Defaults to 100L.

  • t_custom - Integer or NULL. Fixed diffusion time. If NULL, picks the knee automatically. Defaults to NULL.

  • gamma - Numeric. Informational distance constant. 1 is the log potential. Defaults to 1.0.

  • mds_method - String. MDS algorithm for the final embedding. One of c("sgd_dense", "classic"). Defaults to "sgd_dense".

  • mds_iter - Integer or NULL. Number of SGD-MDS iterations. If NULL, the Rust side runs 300 below 1000 points, 500 below 5000 and 800 otherwise (points being the landmarks when landmarks are used). Defaults to NULL.

  • randomised - Boolean. Use randomised SVD for classic MDS (mds_method = "classic"). SGD-MDS initialises from a randomised classic MDS either way. Defaults to TRUE.
